title: Build substantial task knowledge capture pipeline

source.summary: Build and execute a deterministic substantial-task outcome capture pipeline for the governed Obsidian knowledge graph.

decisions.decision: Use explicit curated manifests and a standalone profile-local script
decisions.rationale: Preserve outcome provenance without altering Hermes core or copying transcripts and hidden reasoning

decisions.decision: Fail closed on identity collisions, graph tampering, unsafe paths, and unverified results
decisions.rationale: Make idempotency and privacy controls deterministic and auditable

artifacts.description: Nine-test deterministic security and E2E suite

result: The capture pipeline passed nine tests and an isolated dry-run, first-write, and idempotent-replay smoke sequence.
reusable_lesson: Capture only curated verified outcomes; bind stable source identity to content hashes and fail closed when identity or graph content diverges.

verification.method: Executed unittest suite and preserved isolated-vault CLI smoke
verification.evidence: 9/9 tests passed; smoke statuses were planned with 0 writes, captured with 5 writes, and already_present with 0 writes.
